notes: Only 'Donation Received' entries from Political Party Returns are shown. 'Other Receipt' items (bank transactions, commercial income, loans) are excluded to avoid misrepresenting the donor landscape. Public funding (AEC and state electoral commission payments), tax refunds, and intra-party transfers between state and national branches are excluded. Donor names have been normalised where multiple spellings exist in the AEC data. Data current to 2024-25 financial year (published February 2026). Donations announced after June 2025 — including Gina Rinehart's plane gift to One Nation (April 2026) and Hancock-executive donations of $500,000 each to One Nation — are not yet in this dataset and will appear in the 2025-26 returns due February 2027.
